text: The Fisher-information comparison lacks a common observation model, and rationality plus the stated non-babbling and positive-information conditions do not establish a strict ordering.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Reinforcement Learning from Reputation Feedback (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7456999
abstract: Rationality alone does not support the proposed strict ordering. An empirical comparison would need a common observation model for RLHF and RLRF, an informative Trial round that excludes babbling, and a debate channel with positive conditional information. These are necessary assumptions. This paper does not show that they are sufﬁcient.
